args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 money rounding must use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (`tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` green).
args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
